name: Oficina - Saga e Microsserviços
description: OS Service, Billing e Execution: saga coreografada via RabbitMQ (eventos, retries, DLQ, compensações) e saúde dos serviços.

pages.name: Saga
pages.description: Eventos consumidos por serviço (evento customizado SagaEvento), compensações e status das OS.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Processados' FROM SagaEvento WHERE status = 'processado' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE status = 'retry') AS 'Retries', filter(count(*), WHERE status = 'dlq') AS 'Enviados à DLQ' FROM SagaEvento SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Compensações' FROM SagaCompensacao SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT percentile(latenciaMs, 95) AS 'ms' FROM SagaEvento WHERE status = 'processado' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM SagaEvento FACET eventType TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(latenciaMs, 95) FROM SagaEvento WHERE status = 'processado' FACET eventType
SELECT osId, servico, eventType, status, tentativa, erro FROM SagaEvento WHERE status IN ('retry', 'dlq') SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50
SELECT osId, servico, evento, acao, motivo FROM SagaCompensacao SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM StatusOS FACET novoStatus SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT osId, origem, servico, eventType, status, latenciaMs FROM SagaEvento SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100

pages.name: Serviços
pages.description: Throughput, latência, erros e logs dos três microsserviços.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') FACET appName TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET appName TIMESERIES
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') FACET appName TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') AND transactionType = 'Other' FACET appName, name SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') FACET appName, error.message SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM PagamentoDivergente, WebhookAssinaturaInvalida, FalhaIntegracao FACET eventType() SINCE 1 week ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio por etapa da execução (min)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duracaoMinutos) FROM SagaEtapa FACET statusAnterior SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-billing', 'oficina-execution') AND level IN ('error', 'fatal') FACET entity.name TIMESERIES
